title: Grant AI: Discovery, Fit Scoring & Narrative Drafting
challenge: Grant discovery, eligibility parsing, and narrative drafting are slow and inconsistent. Organizations struggle to identify high-fit opportunities, submissions miss rubric-aligned details, and the manual process of matching grants to organizational needs is time-consuming. Without systematic discovery and scoring, valuable opportunities are missed and submission quality varies significantly.
whyNow: Complex eligibility requirements across multiple sources
Time-intensive manual discovery and matching process
Need for consistent, rubric-aligned narrative quality
Growing number of grant opportunities to track
Limited resources for dedicated grant writing staff
whyNowSummary: Nonprofits, educational institutions, and startups face increasing pressure to secure funding while operating with limited resources. Manual grant discovery and writing processes are unsustainable at scale, creating a critical need for intelligent automation that maintains quality while increasing throughput.
solution: An end-to-end grant workflow platform that automatically discovers opportunities, scores eligibility and fit, drafts rubric-aligned narratives, and tracks submission readiness. The system transforms weeks of manual work into days by intelligently matching organizational needs with grant requirements and generating submission-ready content.
